data.scope: Source preparation and exact data roundtrips only. No native runtime, audio capture or listening acceptance is claimed by this stage.

memory.scope: Conservative resident image plus separate low-RAM work areas; image alignment holes counted as occupied. SID I/O remains visible.

ring.scope: Actual unmodified native execution. Every read has the correct sequential generation, including repeated neutral values. This proves causality beyond matching SID register values.

budget.scope: Unmodified automatic-activation PRG. Every NMI/boundary, exact buffer length and126cycle latch clock checked. RLE fills meet the actual NMI shadow-read deadline; no foreground wait/pointer-swap gate. Costs include hardware entry/RTI and JSR/RTS as stated; final nonreturning NMI is excluded from averages. Ring generations and audio quality require separate proofs.
budget.c3_background_control_scope: Includes active queue/boundary guards and branches between consecutive C3 calls. RLE fills and intervening idle waits excluded; final exit into each idle wait is not charged.

attribution.scope: Exact non-overlapping wall-cycle partition of the unchanged program, excluding startup and terminal shutdown. NMI cycles are removed from every foreground interval. Main-control/busy-wait residual is not a claim that all those cycles can meet an arbitrary new deadline.

all.processing: Native VICE capture, sample-clock crop, DC removal, one shared constant gain. No host mixing, EQ, alignment or dynamics.

autostart.method: Actual VICE -autostartprgmode 1 -autostart of the published player.prg. The reset monitor only sets the completion breakpoint, continues with unaddressed g, reads final counters and exits.
autostart.scope: Normal emulator autoload and complete native register/counter verification. Separate canonical receipts prove causal ring generation and listening WAV identity. No physical SID claim.
